SELECT
    n.id AS notification_id,
    n.type,
    n.destinataire,
    n.statut,
    r.id AS rendez_vous_id,
    r.reference,
    r.nom,
    r.prenom,
    r.email,
    r.telephone,
    r.token_gestion,
    r.motif_annulation,
    c.debut,
    c.fin,
    s.code AS service,
    s.nom AS service_nom,
    si.code AS site,
    si.nom AS site_nom,
    si.adresse AS site_adresse,
    si.timezone AS site_timezone
FROM notifications n
JOIN rendez_vous r ON r.id = n.rendez_vous_id
JOIN creneaux c ON c.id = r.creneau_id
JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id
JOIN sites si ON si.id = c.site_id
WHERE n.statut = 'A_ENVOYER'
  AND n.canal = 'EMAIL'
  AND n.type IN ('CONFIRMATION', 'ANNULATION', 'REPLANIFICATION')
ORDER BY n.created_at ASC;

UPDATE notifications
SET
    statut = 'ENVOYE',
    sent_at = NOW(),
    erreur = NULL
WHERE id = '{{ $('Préparer email transactionnel').item.json.notification_id }}'::uuid
  AND statut = 'A_ENVOYER'
RETURNING
    id,
    rendez_vous_id,
    type,
    canal,
    destinataire,
    statut,
    sent_at;
